bootstrap_policy: Independently authenticate the exact Python3.11.18 executable/stdlib/venv/ensurepip bundled wheels and bootstrap pip before any execution. These are not included in the three-wheel component closure. Build a fresh venv, install exactly the pinned three tool wheels offline with require-hashes/no-deps/no-index, then verify all installed tool bytes. Never use the existing Cloud interpreter3.11.17 as evidence of target3.11.18.
containment_policy: A future reviewed launcher must implement and fixture-test wall/process-group reaping, file/resource caps, bounded sanitized logs and actual filesystem/network isolation. Polling alone is not a hard quota. Missing enforcement or unsupported isolation fails before source execution. No launcher is implemented here.
environment_policy: Build an explicit nonsecret environment; no inherited tokens/proxy/PYTHONPATH/loader overrides/user hooks. Python -I, PIP_CONFIG_FILE=/dev/null, fixed task paths, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH315532800/PYTHONHASHSEED0/TZUTC for package build only. Read-only verified inputs and authenticated Python roots; one writable job tree, no repository/host native-library mounts. Enforce disabled network independently of pip options.
on_failure: Preserve original stage/log/artifacts, consume the future request, no automatic retry or policy relaxation. A new protocol would require review.

checks: exact member set/no duplicates or unsafe paths/links/signatures/extras
all4runtime payload bytes plus license exactly match source
METADATA Name/Version and no runtime requirements/entrypoints
WHEEL purelib/tag, no native extensions, exact RECORD coverage/sha256/sizes
independent original archive/source/tools/recipe/output hashes in external provenance receipt
bounded isolated Python3.11.18 import/version smoke after build; no terminal rendering/provider/model code
output_policy.license_path_policy: Require the exact listed path and bytes for the selected tool recipe. A different path/output is an unsupported result, not an automatic allowlist extension.
output_policy.name: progressbar

requirements_file_policy: Exactly progressbar @ file:///inputs/progressbar-2.5.tar.gz with the measured source SHA256; pip config disabled. No extra dependency index, backend fetch, dependency install, setup_requires override, source fallback or retry.
source_staging_policy: After authenticating bounded archive bytes/members, copy only its closed allowlisted tree into a fresh sandbox-owned source directory; no links/special/extended headers. Preserve input tar unchanged. setup.py imports runtime and may regenerate README. Record source snapshot before/after, require all4runtime.py/license/setup bytes unchanged; permit only known README and generated metadata/build/output paths with recorded hashes. No2to3/patch/substitution.
